evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and adds a unit test in test/fs_tests.cpp verifying filesystem toolchain behavior across platforms.
rationale: Adds unit test coverage in `fs_tests` for an upstream libstdc++ bug on Windows where `std::filesystem::copy_file` fails when overwriting existing files. While it verifies toolchain compatibility that wallet backup logic relies on, it adds an isolated unit test rather than improving core test infrastructure.
